faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our academy.

items.question: At what age can I enroll my child?
items.answer: We accept students from 6 to 18 years old, organized by age groups and development level, ensuring appropriate monitoring for each phase.

items.question: Is previous football experience necessary?
items.answer: No. No previous experience is required. We work with both beginners and young goalkeepers who already play in clubs and want to improve their technique and performance.

items.question: What do I need to bring to training?
items.answer:
The student must bring:
• Comfortable sports equipment
• Samuel Soares Goalkeeper School Jersey
• Goalkeeper gloves
• Cleats suitable for the surface
• Water bottle

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Payment is made monthly, with values adjusted to the weekly frequency of training. All detailed information is provided at the time of registration.

items.question: Are trainings cancelled when it rains?
items.answer: As a general rule, trainings are not cancelled due to rain. Training may be postponed or rescheduled only in extreme weather conditions or when the field does not meet safety conditions.
